records.Title: CPSC Recommends Carbon Monoxide Alarm for Every Home

Products.Name: Fuel- burning appliances - including furnaces, stoves, fireplaces, clothes dryers, water heaters, and space heaters

Hazards.Name: Under certain conditions, fuel-burning appliances can produce deadly CO. However, with proper installation and maintenance, they are safe to use.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should also have the vent pipes on their heating systems inspected. In 1998, virtually the entire furnace and boiler industry together with the manufacturers of high-temperature plastic vent (HTPV) pipes joined with CPSC to announce a vent pipe recall program. The program's purpose is to replace, free of charge, an estimated 250,000 HTPV pipe systems attached to gas or propane furnaces or boilers in consumers' homes. The HTPV pipes could crack or separate at the joints and leak CO.
